mapper.select: SELECT account_id, code, is_active AS active FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND account_type_id = 2
mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_reference, o.merchant_reference, o.account_id AS merchant_account_id, merchant.code AS merchant_code, o.shopper_id, country.iso_code AS shopper_country, subdivision.code AS shopper_country_subdivision, o.currency_id, c.currency_code AS currency, o.net_amount, o.tax_amount, o.gross_amount, o.idempotency_key, o.request_fingerprint, op.payment_reference, op.psp_account_id, psp.code AS psp_code, op.psp_reference, op.payment_link, o.created_ts, payment_country.iso_code AS payment_shopper_country, payment_subdivision.code AS payment_shopper_country_subdivision, o.order_phase FROM merchant_order o JOIN currency c ON c.currency_id = o.currency_id JOIN order_payment op ON op.order_id = o.order_id JOIN account merchant ON merchant.account_id = o.account_id JOIN account psp ON psp.account_id = op.psp_account_id JOIN shopper_detail shopper ON shopper.shopper_id = o.shopper_id JOIN country ON country.country_id = shopper.country_id LEFT JOIN country_subdivision subdivision ON subdivision.country_subdivision_id = shopper.country_subdivision_id JOIN country payment_country ON payment_country.country_id = op.shopper_country_id LEFT JOIN country_subdivision payment_subdivision ON payment_subdivision.country_subdivision_id = op.shopper_country_subdivision_id
mapper.select: INSERT INTO shopper_detail (email, full_name, country_id, country_subdivision_id, postal_code) VALUES (#{order.shopper.email}, #{order.shopper.fullName}, #{order.shopper.countryId}, #{order.shopper.subdivisionId}, #{order.shopper.zipCode}) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name, country_id = EXCLUDED.country_id, country_subdivision_id = EXCLUDED.country_subdivision_id, postal_code = EXCLUDED.postal_code RETURNING shopper_id

INSERT INTO merchant_order ( order_reference, merchant_reference, account_id, account_type_id, shopper_id, currency_id, net_amount, tax_amount, gross_amount, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, order_phase, created_ts ) VALUES ( #{order.orderReference}, #{order.merchantReference}, #{order.merchantAccountId}, 2, #{order.shopperId}, #{order.currencyId}, #{order.netAmount}, #{order.taxAmount}, #{order.grossAmount}, #{order.idempotencyKey}, #{order.requestFingerprint}, 'ORDER_PERSISTED', #{order.createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (account_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING order_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, sequence, product_type_id, order_line_reference, merchant_line_reference, net_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{line.sequence}, #{line.productTypeId}, #{line.orderLineReference}, #{line.merchantLineReference}, #{line.netAmount}, #{line.taxAmount}, CAST(#{line.taxRate} AS NUMERIC) )
mapper.select: SELECT sequence, product_type_id, order_line_reference, merchant_line_reference, net_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY sequence
